name: srsRAN O-RAN SC RIC
description: Simplified O-RAN SC Near-RT RIC (i-release) deployable via a single docker-compose command without Kubernetes or Helm. Includes example KPM and RC xApps.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Building and deploying of the SC RIC as a multi-container application using a single Docker command. docker compose up. Seven services: e2term, e2mgr, dbaas, rtmgr_sim, submgr, appmgr, python_xapp_runner.

eval_notes: Minimal O-RAN RIC without Kubernetes. Perfect for Docker-based agentic evals of xApp development, E2 interface debugging, and RIC management. Best entry point for agentic O-RAN evals: single docker-compose with 7 services (e2term, e2mgr, dbaas, rtmgr_sim, submgr, appmgr, python_xapp_runner). xApps directory mounted for live dev. Works with srsRAN gNB + srsUE for end-to-end testing.
